# squeeze — read long material without filling the chat
A plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that adds one tool, `squeeze`.
> 中文简介：`squeeze` 工具让 Agent 把长网页、多个网页、文本文件或 PDF 交给你选定的辅助模型阅读，只把答案带回对话，原文不占用上下文。注意：原文会发送给作答模型所属的提供方；开启
回退（fallback）时，同一原文可能被发送给列表中另一提供方的模型。文件只通过 DSH 文件系统服务（ctx.fs）读取，被策略拒绝的路径一律拒绝（ACCESS DENIED）。
When an agent needs something from a long web page, a batch of pages, a big text file or a PDF, it c

alls `squeeze`
with a specific question. squeeze downloads or reads the material, hands it to a **he

lper model you choose**, and
returns **only the answer**. The material never enters the main convers

ation, so the agent's context stays small and
cheap.
Typical uses: pull figures out of a long report, find one section in a large log or code file, compa

re a few web
pages, summarise a transcript.

ndred

(A real call from 3 Nov 2026, answered by a local model; the answer is shortened here.)
The status line tells the agent which model answered, how long it took and how big the source was. F

ailures say
what went wrong and what to do next (for example `squeeze SOURCE PROBLEM: … this PDF has

no text layer (probably a
scan or photo) — it needs OCR`).
## Settings page
## Features
- **Models from your DSH model list** — pick a default model and up to two extra ones on the plugin'

s own settings
page. Nothing to type twice: whatever providers and models DSH already knows are offe

red.
- **Nicknames and "when to use" notes** — give each model a short nickname (`quick`, `careful`,

…) and a one-line
note. The agent sees them in its tool description and picks a model by nickname.
- **Fixed thinking level per model** — you decide how hard each model thinks; the agent cannot chang

e it.
- **Size limit follows the model** — each model's limit is worked out from its context window
(default: the material may use 80% of it, the rest is left for thinking and the answer). The agent s

ees the limit
per model.
- **Optional fallback** — when switched on, a model that is unreachable, re

turns a server error, has left the model
list, or is too small for the material is skipped and the n

ext model in your list is tried. The answer's status
line says which model answered and why the othe

rs were skipped. Time-outs do not fall back.
- **Clear errors** — every failure starts with a kind t

he agent can act on (`REQUEST PROBLEM`, `SOURCE PROBLEM`,
`TOO BIG`, `MODEL UNAVAILABLE`, `NO ANSWER

`, `TIMED OUT`, `CANCELLED`, `ACCESS DENIED`) and ends with the next step.
- **Batches of pages** —

up to 20 addresses per call (configurable), downloaded four at a time; dead pages are
skipped and li

sted instead of failing the whole call.
- **PDFs** — PDF links and PDF files with a text layer are c

onverted to text automatically when the free
`pdftotext` program (poppler; `brew install poppler` on

a Mac) is installed. Scanned PDFs are refused with
advice to use OCR.
- **Sites with huge headers**

— some government portals send more header data than Node's built-in downloader
accepts (16 KB); sq

ueeze retries those with a larger limit.
- **Short pages** — a page with almost no text (often a Jav

aScript-only or blocked page) is handed back to the agent
as-is without a model call (or refused, if

you prefer).
- **One call at a time per provider** — calls to the same provider queue, so a single

local model is never
[该节后续省略]
## Install
Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer. For PDF support also install `pdftotext` (`brew install poppler` o
DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer. For PDF support also install `pdftotext` (`brew install poppler` on a Mac).
**From the GitHub release** — ask the DSH agent:
> Install the bundle `https://github.com/q8atnight/dsh-squeeze/releases/download/v2.1.0/dsh-squeeze-
2.1.0.tgz` with the plugin manager.
(It uses `plugin_manager` → `install_bundle` with that address. You can also download the `.tgz` fil

e and give the
agent its path instead.)
**From a folder** — clone or unpack this repository somewhere permanent (for example `~/.dsh/plugins

/dsh-squeeze`)
and ask the agent to install the bundle at that folder.
Then restart DSH if the plugin manager says a restart is needed, and open **Plugins → squeeze → Conf

igure** to
choose your models.
Without any model chosen, squeeze uses the DSH default chat model.
## Settings
| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| Helper models | — | Default + up to 2 extra: model, nickname, thinking level, "when to use" note.

The same model can be listed only once. |
| Fallback | off | Try the next model when one is down or

too small. |
| Context fill (%) | 80 | Share of each model's context window the material may use. |

| Output budget (tokens) | 16,000 | Thinking + answer, capped at the model's own maximum. |
| Time l

imit per model call (s) | 600 | Longer calls are stopped and reported. |
| Time limit per page downl

oad (s) | 30 | |
| Web addresses per call | 20 | |
| Longest answer (characters) | 6,000 | Longer an

swers are cut at a line break and marked `ANSWER CUT`. |
| Minimum page length (characters) | 300 |

Below this a single page is treated as "probably JavaScript-only or blocked". |
| Pages under the mi
nimum length | hand over as-is | Or refuse with an error. |
Changes apply to the next tool call; open sessions see the new tool description from their next requ
ges apply to the next tool call; open sessions see the new tool description from their next request.
## The tool (what the agent sees)
Parameters: `prompt` (required), and one source — `url`, `urls` (list) or `file` (path; `file_path`

is accepted
too) — plus `model` (a nickname) when more than one model is set up.
The result is the answer followed by a status line, for example:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Limits
- Text, HTML and text PDFs only (PDFs need `pdftotext`). Convert Word or Excel files to text first;

scans and
photos need OCR.
